# Mini Brains Trust

> An Australian screen-free daily-play app and at-home kindy curriculum for 3 to 5 year olds. One planned, ten-minute, screen-free activity a day that grows the human skills a screen can't teach. Built by an Australian family. No ads, no data harvesting.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://minibrainstrust.com.au/): what Mini Brains Trust is and how it works
- [About](https://minibrainstrust.com.au/about/): the Australian family behind it
- [School readiness](https://minibrainstrust.com.au/school-readiness/): getting 3 to 5 year olds ready for kindy
- [Pricing](https://minibrainstrust.com.au/pricing/): plans and what's included
- [FAQ](https://minibrainstrust.com.au/faq/): common questions from parents
